hospital_course: The patient presented with complaints of multiple episodes of loose stools, vomiting, fatigue for 3 days, and fever for one day. Initial investigations revealed elevated serum creatinine (1.65mg/dl), low serum sodium (128.00mmol/L), and a normal CBC. Urinalysis showed ketone bodies, pus cells, and bacteria. The patient was admitted and treated with IV fluids, IV antibiotics, IV PPI's, and IV antiemetics. An ultrasound of the abdomen and pelvis showed Grade-I fatty liver changes and features suggestive of colitis. Repeat serum creatinine was normal (1.17mg/dl). TSH and Free T4 were also normal. The patient was discharged at the request of family against medical advice for further management.

admission_medications.note: Patient has a history of a thyroid disorder and was on treatment. The specific medication is not named in the documents.

follow_up: Review immediately in case of fever, loose stools, vomiting, fatigue. Review on 09.03.2026. CBC. Follow up on pending urine culture and sensitivity report.
